name: newgui
description: Cross-platform C++ UI toolkit inspired by the Haiku Interface Kit

tests.description: Unit tests and the test kit (ngui_testkit): GoogleTest, and libpng for the PNG files of image snapshots

skia.description: Skia backend (CPU raster): PNG for screenshots, FreeType for typefaces made from the text subsystem's font files (specification 13.4); no GPU, no fontconfig (finding fonts is the text subsystem's job), no HarfBuzz/ICU (shaping too). FreeType is listed directly to switch off its default features (brotli, bzip2): vcpkg honours default-features false of a transitive dependency only if the manifest says so too.
